description: Tool to create a custom metric in Google Analytics. Use when you need to define a new custom metric for tracking specific event parameters.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a CustomMetric.

description.description: Optional. Description for this custom metric. Max length of 150 characters.
examples: Test custom metric created via API
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Required. Display name for this custom metric as shown in the Analytics UI. Max length of 82 characters, alphanumeric plus space and underscore starting with a letter.
displayName.title: Display Name

measurementUnit.description: Required. The type for the custom metric's value.
measurementUnit.title: Measurement Unit

parameterName.description: Required. Immutable. Tagging name for this custom metric. If this is an event-scoped metric, then this is the event parameter name. May only contain alphanumeric and underscore characters, starting with a letter. Max length of 40 characters for event-scoped metrics.
parameterName.title: Parameter Name

parent.description: Required. The property where the custom metric will be created. Format: properties/{property_id}
parent.title: Parent

restrictedMetricType.description: Optional. Types of restricted data that this metric may contain. Required for metrics with CURRENCY measurement unit. Must be empty for metrics with a non-CURRENCY measurement unit.
restrictedMetricType.title: Restricted Metric Type

scope.description: Required. Immutable. The scope of this custom metric.
scope.title: Scope

inputSchema.title: CreateCustomMetricRequest

name: create_custom_metric

CreateCustomMetricResponse.description: Response model for a created CustomMetric.

displayName.description: Display name for this custom metric as shown in the Analytics UI.
displayName.title: Display Name

measurementUnit.description: The type for the custom metric's value.
measurementUnit.title: Measurement Unit

name.description: Output only. Resource name for this CustomMetric resource. Format: properties/{property}/customMetrics/{customMetric}
name.title: Name

parameterName.description: Immutable. Tagging name for this custom metric.
parameterName.title: Parameter Name

restrictedMetricType.description: Types of restricted data that this metric may contain.
restrictedMetricType.title: Restricted Metric Type

scope.description: Immutable. The scope of this custom metric.
scope.title: Scope
